requirements.text: There shall be two levels of access; one for teachers and assistants and one for administrators.
The teachers and assistants shall only be allowed to enter or edit child comments and child arrival or departure times.
The administrators shall be allowed to enter or edit all data.
Only the administrators shall be allowed to view or print reports.
Only the administrators shall be allowed to view or print invoices.
All employees shall be allowed to use the Daily Reminders.
Each user shall be required to log on with a unique user name and password before using the system.
A password shall be assigned to each user.
The password shall contain 6 to 8 alphanumeric characters.
A new password shall be assigned if a user forgets.
Users shall only be allowed to set daily reminders for themselves.
A child's record shall contain the dates that their required immunizations were received.
A child's record shall contain the date of their last physical examination.
If only a single child is enrolled a parent shall be billed $90 at the end of the each month.
If only two children are enrolled a parent shall be billed $157.50 at the end of each month.
If more than two children are enrolled a parent shall be billed $157.50 for the first two children plus $45 for each additional child at the end of each month.
An account history for each customer shall contain all activity by date.
Itemized customer invoices showing amount due shall be available for printing.
Customers shall be billed $10 an hour (per child) for late pick ups.
All invoices shall be available for printing at the end of each month.
The software shall support the ability to enter, store, and update parent, child and billing information.
Each classroom shall only accept a maximum of 20 children.
Each student shall only belong to one class
One teacher and one assistant shall be assigned to each class.
A waiting list shall store the names and phone numbers of up to 100 potential customers waiting for a classroom opening to enroll their child.
The system shall have a Web based interface that works with Internet Explorer and Netscape Navigator.
The background color of all windows shall be blue.
The system shall respond to all user requests within 20 seconds.
The password shall be at least 12 characters long, include a mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters, and be hashed using a strong, salted algorithm (e.g., Argon2 or bcrypt).
The system shall implement secure session management, including the use of secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite cookies, and enforce session invalidation upon logout or inactivity.
Password recovery shall be performed via a secure, time-limited, single-use token sent to the user's verified email address, rather than manual assignment.
The system shall respond to all interactive user requests within 2 seconds under a load of 50 concurrent users.
Passwords shall be at least 12 characters long, including a mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters, and must be hashed using a strong, salted algorithm (e.g., Argon2 or bcrypt).
The system shall respond to 95% of user requests within 2 seconds under a concurrent load of 50 users.

OPEN: The PRD lacks requirements for data encryption in transit and at rest. - All data in transit shall be encrypted using TLS 1.3 or higher, and all sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) in the database shall be encrypted at rest.

OPEN: The PRD does not address protection against common web vulnerabilities. - The application shall be designed to prevent common web vulnerabilities, including SQL injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), and Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF).

OPEN: There is no mention of data backup, recovery, or disaster recovery procedures for critical child care and billing records. - The system shall perform automated daily backups of the database, with a recovery point objective (RPO) of 24 hours and a recovery time objective (RTO) of 4 hours.

OPEN: The requirement for browser support is outdated and lacks a strategy for handling modern browser security or rendering standards. - The system shall be compatible with the current stable versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge, and shall implement a Content Security Policy (CSP) to mitigate cross-site scripting risks.

OPEN: The PRD does not define the expected number of concurrent users, total number of children, or total number of facilities, making it impossible to size the database or server infrastructure. - The system shall support up to 500 concurrent users and a database containing records for up to 10,000 children.
